description: Header file defining Vulkan API QueryPool class and related structures for shader profiling and timing within the ATen native Vulkan backend.

classes.name: QueryPool
classes.description: Manages Vulkan query pools for shader profiling, timing, and result extraction.

classes.name: QueryPoolConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for initializing a QueryPool.

classes.name: ShaderDuration
classes.description: Stores execution timing and kernel information for shader profiling.

methods.name: QueryPool
methods.description: Constructor initializing the QueryPool with configuration and adapter.

methods.name: ~QueryPool
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up QueryPool resources.

methods.name: is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the query pool is active.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the query pool with a command buffer.

methods.name: shader_profile_begin
methods.description: Starts profiling a shader with given parameters.

methods.name: shader_profile_end
methods.description: Ends profiling a shader with a given query index.

methods.name: extract_results
methods.description: Retrieves profiling results from the query pool.

methods.name: get_total_op_ns
methods.description: Returns total execution time in nanoseconds for a specific operation.

methods.name: shader_log_for_each
methods.description: Applies a function to each shader duration log entry.

methods.name: get_shader_name_and_execution_duration_ns
methods.description: Retrieves shader name and execution duration for a specific query index.

methods.name: shader_logs_entry_count
methods.description: Returns total number of shader log entries.
